meta.name: li-dm
meta.description: Write connection notes and DM follow-ups that get replies - the 200-character invite, the first message, and the two follow-ups. Use when the user says "write a connection request", "DM this person", "outreach message", "how do I follow up", or is reaching out to someone specific on LinkedIn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出能收到回复的领英好友邀请与私信跟进
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在领英上联系陌生客户或同行,却不知道怎么开口。
copy.tagline_en: Write LinkedIn invites and DM follow-ups that actually get replies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to reach strangers or peers on LinkedIn but don't know how to open.

howto.what: 帮你写 LinkedIn 加好友备注（200 字符，附字符计数）、对方通过后的第一条私信，以及两条跟进消息。动笔前它先问你对方是谁、为什么现在联系、你想要什么。
howto.when: 当你说“写个好友申请”“私信这个人”等说法，或要为 LinkedIn 上某个具体的人发消息时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这位产品经理写个 200 字符的好友备注
say.note: 它会先问你现在联系他的具体理由

say.text: 他通过好友了，帮我写第一条私信
say.note: 输出 2~4 句，含一个很小的请求

say.text: 再给我两条跟进，标上第几天发
say.note: 一条 +4 天，一条 +10 天收尾

howto.what_en: Writes your LinkedIn connection note (200 characters, count shown), the first DM after they accept, and two follow-ups with send days. Before writing it asks who they are, why now, and what you want.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "write a connection request", "DM this person", or similar, or when you're reaching out to someone specific on LinkedIn.

say_en.text: Write a 200-character connection note for this PM.
say_en.note: It first asks your specific reason for reaching out.

say_en.text: They accepted — draft my first DM.
say_en.note: Two to four sentences, one small ask.

say_en.text: Give me the two follow-ups with send days.
say_en.note: One at +4 days, one closing the loop at +10.
